facts.text: Caroline mentioned that the pride event was encouraging and filled with love and acceptance.

evidence.quote: The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.

facts.text: Caroline described a moment where her mentee's face lit up upon seeing the support at the pride event.

evidence.quote: Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best! Such a special moment.

facts.text: Caroline mentors a transgender teen and has been working on building confidence and finding positive strategies with them.

evidence.quote: I mentor a transgender teen just like me. We've been working on building up confidence and finding positive strategies, and it's really been paying off!

facts.text: Caroline is planning an LGBTQ art show with her paintings for the next month.

evidence.quote: Yay! Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!
